notes.title: Warhammer: Chaosbane - Slayer Edition Patch Notes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33961441/180c95ed0e58d36ea25c2caf17ddc7f1bfc6ae8e.png
We're excited to announce the release of the Slayer Edition of Warhammer: Chaosbane onto Steam. The Slayer Edition is a new package for the game, which includes all of the content that's been released for Chaosbane thus far, including the Tomb Kings, and the Witch Hunter. The price of the Slayer Edition varies depending on what DLC you own.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/16609/Warhammer_Chaosbane__Slayer_Edition/
Alternatively, you can purchase the Witch Hunter separately. The Slayer Edition, and Witch Hunter release alongside a number of FREE updates to the core experience, bringing new zones, new enemies, and more. You can find the full list in the patch notes: 

Patch Notes: 
Release of the Witch Hunter
Jurgen Haider, the Witch Hunter makes his way into Warhammer: Chaosbane. The Witch Hunter is able to switch between 2 styles, either getting up close and personal with his sword, or exhausting the gunnery school's ammo reserves as you rain down bullets on those who would oppose you. notes.title: Tower of Chaos Patch Notes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33961441/5f86090e4f00d6c4918113bb97c9ceed8894b6f2.png

Welcome to the Tower of Chaos heroes! 

We hope you're ready to take on the challenge offered by the Tower of Chaos, the newest game mode in Warhammer: Chaosbane. The premise is simple, the higher you climb, the better the reward, and tougher the challenge. If you fail, then you'll be walking away with nothing but a bruised ego. The tower is accessible after you've cleared the Act 2. 

There's a lot of other things included in this patch, changes to Boss Rush and Relic Hunt, a new currency called Morrisleb coins, balance tweaks, and much more. So make sure you read on for the full patch notes. 

Before you go, we wanted to thank you all for all the support we've received over the past year. Your feedback has helped shape the development of Warhammer: Chaosbane in. We're not done yet either, we've got something special planned, so put down your cloaks for now, and stay tuned. We'll be back with more information later this year.

Anyway, let's move onto the patch notes:

HOTFIX: Keela can now reclaim rewards in the Invasion mode. 
 Fixed some UI problems when not using the 16/9 aspect ratio.
 Resolved some miscellaneous crash fixes.

Gameplay New Mode Added – The Tower Of Chaos The Tower of Chaos is a new arena in which you can test your skills in various battle challenges, the higher you climb, the better quality loot you’ll receive. After you clear each floor, you can decide whether to take the rewards and end your journey here or push onward for better rewards. 
Relic Hunt and Boss Rush ReworkMore options have been given to the player, to choose the maps and modifiers they’re interested in playing. You’ll receive better loot based on what modifiers you select and will be able to custom-tune the challenge. Added the possibility to chain some skills during the use of other combat skills without interrupting animations
Cosmetic menu added, allowing you to replace the visuals of your gear with other gear you own

notes.title: October Update Now Live!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33961441/776bb1d05cdc9b06be038f7dceb4343a65a46318.png

5th November Hotfix: we've applied a hotfix to Chaosbane to resolve some issues with player profiles that some users were experiencing. 

The October Update is now live on Steam! Permadeath mode has been added to Warhammer: Chaosbane, start a new character and take on the challenges of the Old World, but one where the stakes are much higher. 

That's not all we have in store, so make sure you read on for the full patch notes. 

Features:
 Permadeath mode added to the game
Make a new character and put your heroic skills to the ultimate challenge, in hardcore mode death is permanent. In the Old World death is certain, it’s just how long you can stave it off for. Find the records of slain heroes in the Pantheon, what is the highest legendary rank you can reach we wonder. 
 Build Preset options added for equipment, skills, god skills and legendary rank bonuses.
 Chaos 8 Difficulty added
 All elite enemies are now marked with an icon above their head, this way you can easily spot them as they still have their own specific loot list with better chances for high quality items
Paid Content
 New Pet DLC content has been added
Interface
 Heroic items (red and green) are now displayed on the map
 Semi-bosses have been given a life gauge, they still have their specific loot list for heroic drops
 Legendary rank is now displayed in all interfaces
 New FX added to some heroic items
 An arrow on the map now indicates the position of faraway objectives
Gameplay
 ‘Damage over time resistance’ stat has been added
 New guild passives have been added, icons have also been updated
 New Relic Hunt modifiers have been added for each Chaos God Nurgle: Regular ground AOEs inflicting poison damage
 Khorne: Regular ground AOEs inflicting physical damage
 Slaanesh: Regular ground AOEs inflicting magical damage
 Tzeentch: Regular ground AOEs inflicting fire damage
 Invasion loot bonus has been increased (+100% per rank, up from +10% per rank), playing at high Invasion rank will give you better chances to loot heroic items
Balancing:
 High level enemy HP gauge reworked
 The loot bonus from ‘Death Benediction’ is now 200% (from 100%)
 The gold loot bonus from the guild skill is 20% (up from 10%) and the loot rate bonus 200% (up from 100%)
 Relic hunt modifier that reduced critical hit rate is -50% (previously -100%)
 Resurrection costs increased, 15% of all gold or 50 fragments of each colour (up from 10% and 20)

Elessa

 ‘Elven Shot’ slow effect rate has been decreased
 ‘Follow Tracks – Superior’ life regen effect has been decreased
 ‘Wild Incarnation’ summoned pets deal increased damage

New Loot Items Added
 New ring added: Improves DOT damage after using your archetype ability
 New necklace: Improved loot drop quality based on critical hit, when you use this item there’s a chance to spawn an elite enemy with a unique loot list. 
Item Balancing

 The Axe ‘Victor’s Tribute’ now grants +50% damage, stacking up to 5 times, lasting 30s instead of 20s

notes.title: September Update (1.08)
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33961441/df7e5681df88eb005c6f632642d176078348f8d1.png

The September update is here, bringing with it the Legendary Rank system which includes some new abilities, a rework of the blessing system and much more. 

New features and improvements
 Legendary Ranks added
Once you reach maximum level, keep earning XP in order to increase your legendary rank. This menu is accessible from your character sheet by selecting “Legendary Rank” at the bottom of the screen.
 Blessing System Update
The blessing system is now deeper, identical for all characters, and you see the result of the craft prior to validation. 

Please Note: You are going to need a lot of fragments! Keep in mind that more fragments drop when you use “Bloodlust” on enemies. Do not forget you can swap fragments at the Collector’s guild. 
 Improved the God Skill Tree ergonomics
You can now click any node on the tree and unlock the whole tree up to this node if you have enough favor points. You can cancel one or multiple nodes the same way. This will let you test multiple combinations.
 Added a new heroic set as T4 (red) and T5 (green) for each character. 

Season Pass Content
 Additional God Skill Tree
Each character will receive an additional god skill tree with new nodes, passive and active abilities. It’s possible to invest points across both skill trees to customize a build that works for you as a player. 

All Characters
 Added a new statistic "damage over time" (DOT). All damage over time abilities are now linked to this specific statistic and not raw damage.
 Reworked the balance between energy gain and damage from skills that generate energy.

Empire Soldier
 The "Taunt" skill improved by the "Meteoric Iron" armor set now has the correct damage set for enemies.
 “Defense stance” skill has been balanced.

Dwarf Slayer
 The rage bonus granted with "Eternal Grudge” has been increased from 2 seconds to 3 seconds.
 "Call of the Oath" has been modified so it does not generate a 5 stack of rage as it used to.
 The aura granted with the "Grimnir’s tatoos" set has been decreased, damage decreased, bonus damage linked to your % of life lost increased, flaming visual effect removed.
 “Avenging charge” damage decreased.
 Added a damage bonus for allies when using the improved version of “Call of Oath”.
 Changed the bonus granted from the "Last Song" set: it now improves the "Deep gashes" passive skill.
 Fixed the “Strike of the Anvil” skill bonuses (Mastered version), these now apply correctly. 

Wood Elf
 Fixed the hitbox of “Elven Shot” so smaller enemies can be hit better and increased range of action when using the “Mastered” version of the skill.
 Fixed the distance at which Dryads appear when using “Call of the spirits".
 “Tactical retreat” has been balanced.
 “Lone hunter” has been balanced.

Gameplay
 DOT no longer kills players when they remove more than 5% of total health at once.
 DOT do less damage in very high difficulty levels.
 Removed controller vibration on skills that inflict DOT.

Gear
 Critical damage stats added to amulets. 
 Bonuses adjusted for “The impatient One” and “Heart-Seeker” Slayer axes.

Enemies
 Enemies’ attack speed rebalanced
 Enemies’ health and damage have been adjusted based on difficulty level.
 Changed enemy patterns:
New skills added to multiple enemies depending on their Chaos faction.
Khorne
Range cultists, cultist leaders, Bloodletters, Bloodcrushers, Chaos Spawns, Giant Chaos Spawns, Jabberslythes and Mutaliths now have a probability to earn a damage and defense bonus when their health is low.
Nurgle
Nurglings, Cultists, range Cultists and summoners now have a probability to move away from the player when their life is low.
Slaneesh
Cultists, range Cultists and summoners now briefly move away from the player when they are hurt.
For a brief moment, Cultist leaders, daemonette, Herald and Chaos Spawn have their attack speed increased when their life is low.
For a brief moment, Cultist leaders, daemonette, Herald and Chaos Spawn are immune to crowd control when their life is low.
Tzeentch
Cultists, range Cultists, Blue Horrors and Pink Horrors now briefly move away from the player when they are hurt.
 Giant Chaos Spawn do normal damages in close-quarter combat.
 Great Unclean One: damage done by the rock fall has been decreased.
 Decreased the overall number of heralds in Act 3 (in all game modes).

Misc
 “Elite” enemies have a higher green loot drop rate (T5 gear).
 Boss have a lower red loot drop rate (T4 gear).
 Creatures summoned by enemies do not give XP or loot anymore.
 Fixed some skill and gear tooltips.
 Fixed some issues in the Japanese translation of the in-game texts.
 Fixed some collision bugs with the props.

notes.title: Update Preview: Legendary Rank System
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33961441/913ff45318b1a62d3cbef27f3f310c769c52132a.png

It’s going to be LEGEN -wait for it- DARY!

The Legendary Rank system gives level 50 players six new passive skills, each passive has two influencing factors, the strength and proc chance. Proc chance has a limit, but some power levels have no upper limit meaning your potential power level is over 9000!

The Legendary Rank system will be a part of the next update for Warhammer: Chaosbane.

notes.title: Invasion Hotfix 2 & Invasion Notes (1.04)
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone, 

We've pushed a small hotfix live to the Invasion Mode, read on for more details and a general guide to Invasion Mode. 

Hotfix Notes
 Nodes now correctly unlock for all players in multiplayer.
 A node finished at a specific Rank now also unlock the same node on inferior Ranks, and progress isn't lost when changing Rank.
 Fixed some texts.

Invasion Mode Guide
We wanted to take a moment to offer a more in-depth explanation as to how the Invasion Mode works. 

Each node represents a level with predetermined modifiers, a difficulty and a level of Chaos Corruption. The in-game difficulty level does not affect Invasion missions.

When you play Invasion, you can choose it's "Rank". The higher it is, the more resistant enemies will be (+5% per rank), hit harder (+5% damage per rank) and your chances at finding better quality items will increase (+10% Loot Quality per Rank). 

Each Invasion mission has a percentage of Chaos Corruption, this represented the life that your character loses each second. You can reduce this by unlocking certain nodes on the Invasion tree.

In multiplayer, we use the invasion card of the player who starts a mission. Progression will be saved for other players if they have access to this mission on their tree. A warning message will display if you do not meet the requirements for your progress to be recorded. 

Completed missions at higher Ranks will automatically unlock the same nodes at lower ranks. For example, if you unlock a mission at Rank 5, it will also be available for ranks 1-4. However, it will not be available for Ranks 6 and above. You can change rank at any time without losing your progress at your current rank. 

When you clear a Rank completely (100%) you unlock the next 10 ranks. So for example, if you clear Rank 7, you will unlock Ranks 8 to 18. At first you only have access to Ranks 1 to 10. 

What's the highest Rank you will clear completely? In the next update this Rank will be displayed on your character icon in Multiplayer. 


Note: Relic Hunt mode, with its bonus to item quality, remains the best way to farm higher quality items (T4 Red and T5 Green). If a node is too difficult, perhaps you should gear up in Relic Hunt mode.

Howdy Everyone,

The first patch for Warhammer: Chaosbane is now live for PC. Notable inclusions are a new gear rarity (time to start hunting those Greens), Invasion Mode and the squashing of some bugs related to bugged progression or lost characters.

Read on for the full patch notes:

Features
 A new rarity level for gear T5 (Green) gear that provides a new upgrade for all armors, rings, weapons, and amulets. These have the same set effects as T4 and can be stacked with T4 armor (so you won’t have to wait for a complete set for the effect).

 Option To Limit FPS
 Balancing Changes
 Loot drop rate

 Fragment bonus’ has been removed from Relic Hunt
 Bosses difficulty adjustments
 God Tree:
 Bonuses have been rebalanced

Misc
 Passive Slots Upgraded to 6
 Fanity Slots Upgraded to 12
 Added an option to display loot permanently on the ground
 Players will no longer die to DOT (Damage Over Time) effects alone
 10 new levels of reputation have been added to the collector’s guild

 The pause menu now shows current global quality loot bonus, current difficulty and the map modifiers (for Relic Hunt and Invasion).
 The map size key is not a toggle when playing with mouse and keyboard (you no longer have to hold for map zoom).

Bug Fixes

 Random crash fixes

 a backup save system has also been added to make sure you won’t lose your characters

Slayer dash skill will no longer take the player out of bounds

Fixed an issue where some people were ending up with more than 100 skill points


Enemies

notes.title: New Endgame Mode Added Next Week + Pre-Patch Notes
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33961441/467ad1c194fdb1a3fd711879d35d4558c9003e5a.jpg

Howdy Everyone,

Wanted to get back to you with some information about what's been going on, and our planned updates + patch notes for next week. Keep in mind, these aren't final, some things may change, but they should serve to give a general idea of what you can expect.

NEW GAME MODE - INVASION

An Invasion map is played out on randomly generated levels from specific acts, Boss Fights or Arena battles with waves of enemies. Each Invasion tree node may be modified by some alterations, depending on the dark god they’re related to (poison for Nurgle, Magic Shields for Tzeentch as examples).

During this time, you’ll also be fighting against Corruption. This manifests as a life draining effect that players will have to endure. Each map has a corruption value, which becomes increasingly harsher the further a player moves away from the origin of the Invasion node trees. At the end of each invasion tree branch, you unlock powerful rewards that are exclusive to this mode, including: new skills, new heroic jewels and new potion effects.

The difficulty of Invasion is also defined by its Rank. Finishing an Invasion at a specific Rank will unlock higher Ranks and tougher Invasions. Try to find new rarity objects to become stronger and aim to complete the highest Rank possible. Invasion will release with the next patch.

Patch Notes 
PLEASE NOTE: These are not final, but should give a general idea of what you can expect!

Features:
 Adding stages 11 through 20 for the collector’s guild.
 Adding an option to display loot permanently.
 Adding two new difficulty levels, Chaos 6 and Chaos 7.
Balancing:
 Rebalancing a number of boss encounters throughout the game.
 Damage over time effects (poison, bleeding, etc) will no longer kill players. If a player is very low on health, DOT effects will not bring them to below 1HP.
Technical Updates:
 Option added to activate or deactivate Depth of Field
 Option added to activate or deactivate temporal anti-aliasing.
 Option added to activate or deactivate MLAA.
 Option added to activate or deactivate volumetric lighting
Bug Fixes
 Fixing a bug occurring in endgame modes (Relic hunt, etc) where changing online visibility could crash the dungeon
 Fixing a bug that could display a boss’ life meter multiple times
 Fixing a bug that prevented NPCs from changing position when completing the campaign
 Fixing the way controls are displayed in the « revive » window
 Fixing the way modifiers are displayed in Relic Hunt mode
 Fixing a bug on filters in the skill menu
 Fixing a bug when trying to assign the Shift or Alt key in the key binding menu
 Pets will now correctly increase the loot radius

Localization
 Font will be changed for Japanese text

notes.title: Day 1 - Developer Update
notes.notes:
Version 1.0 of Warhammer: Chaosbane is live. It’s been an intense experience and a lot of hard work. Thank you to everyone who's been playing, and for all the feedback, both positive and negative. 

We’ve got a lot of data to sort through. Regardless of how much preparation you do, the first few days of launch dwarf any preparation that is done prior. We’re reading through the forums, Reddit, Social Media, Discord and bug reporting form in order to centralize your feedback. So we can break it into action points and come back to you with our next steps. 

The Bigben team is answering the community as much as possible, and they’ll be working with us to ensure you’re kept up to date about our next steps. For us at Eko, we’ve got some bugs to squash and will be spending our time and energy on improving the game. 

We have a series of plans to support, extend and improve Chaosbane. We won’t be able to solve everything in one day, but we’re dedicated to ensuring that we're moving in the right direction. 

We should have the first update next week, with an update description later this week. Bigger updates will require a little more time, especially since we’re working within a license we love, but one that needs to be respected. 

We’ve got some exciting things. So stay tuned, and once again thank you for your feedback and support. 

Chaos will be defeated!
Eko Software team.

notes.title: Warhammer: Chaosbane gets a release date, pre-order bonuses detailed
notes.notes: Warhammer: Chaosbane, a new action RPG set in the Warhammer fantasy universe, is set for release on June 4. Along with the game's release date, Bigben and Eko Software have also announced pre-order bonuses, which will include two beta phases, starting next month.The beta, which will be open to anyone that pre-orders the game, will be in two phases—the first is set for March, with the second following a month later in April. The beta will allow players to sample the beginning of the campaign, as well as test out the four different classes both solo and in co-op mode. Further details are expected regarding the dates and content of the beta phases at a later date.In addition to beta access, players who preorder Warhammer: Chaosbane will receive an experience bonus which will remain active for the entirety of the character’s progression as well as a pack of four legendary crates (ah yes, computer games in 2019). You can check out further details at the official site.Warhammer: Chaosbane was announced in June last year and might look familiar to fans of Diablo or the more recent Warhammer title, Warhammer 40,000: Inquisitor—Martyr. Chaosbane will allow you to choose one of four character-based classes, each with a specific role and skillset. There's also a unique bloodlust mechanic to help take down tricky bosses, granting speed and additional powers—the duration and number of additional skills will be based on your Bloodlust level—all of which lends itself to the drop-in co-op that is present.Warhammer: Chaosbane is set for release on June 4.
